DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Say It to the Mirror

STS-MS7-L1-6501000-MSVPA-MMG-NAV-02 • MS Visual and Performing Arts: Music • Performance Decorum and Audience Etiquette
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Old American theaters like the Orpheum gave performers a mirror before they ever gave them a stage, because the mirror tells the truth about a bow, a collar, and a nervous face. Musicians in jazz halls, school gyms, and church basements all learned the same lesson: the room changes what counts as polite. A shout that lifts a crowd at an outdoor festival can stop a quiet concert cold.
If your band played the same set in a school gym instead of the Orpheum, which one of the three audience rules would you change, and why?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
